sentences.text: Con Man is an American comedy web series created , written , directed by , and starring Alan Tudyk .	Alan Tudyk	Alan Tudyk
The series follows cult science fiction actor Wray Nerely -LRB- Tudyk -RRB- , as he tours the convention circuit .	convention	fan convention
Tudyk , one of the stars of the 2002 science fiction TV show Firefly , based Con Man loosely upon his own experiences .	Firefly	Firefly (TV series)
The series is co-produced by PJ Haarsma and by Nathan Fillion , who also co-stars in it .	Nathan Fillion	Nathan Fillion	PJ Haarsma	PJ Haarsma
Crowdfunded through Indiegogo , Con Man set records for crowdfunding a web series by raising more than $ 1 million in 24 hours and more than $ 3.1 million overall .	Indiegogo	Indiegogo
The series premiered on September 30 , 2015 , on Vimeo , with the first season consisting of 13 episodes .	Vimeo	Vimeo
The second season premiered on December 8 , 2016 on Comic-Con HQ , Comic-Con 's subscription streaming video service , consisted of 12 episodes , and concluded on January 26 , 2017 .
